g.text: OpenAdapt quickstart: show a task once, run it, then watch it catch a save that didn't happen.
Synthetic data only. Files go to openadapt-quickstart
[1/5] ✓ Clinic app ready · synthetic data, on this computer
[2/5] Show it once · a demonstration in a synthetic clinic app, in a hidden browser
✓ Click Open 0.3s
✓ Click New Encounter 0.6s
✓ Click Triage 0.8s
✓ Click Note 1.0s
✓ Type "Synthetic follow-up in two weeks" 1.3s
✓ Click Save Encounter 1.5s
[3/5] ✓ Turn it into a program · 6 steps, local-quickstart 3.9s
[4/5] Run it on a new note
1/1 Follow-up in two weeks ✓ checked in the database 3.0s
1 of 1 saved and checked · 0 AI calls · $0.00 · 3.0s
✓ Saved and checked
The record, read back from the database:
✓ patient_id p1
✓ type Triage
✓ source replay
✓ key mockmed-triage-p1-v1
✓ note "Follow-up in two weeks"
1 of 1 run · 0 model calls · $0.00 · 3.0s
[5/5] Break the next save
The app will show its saved message. The database will reject the save.
The screen: "Encounter saved — Synthetic follow-up in two weeks"
The database: 0 new records
A screen-trusting bot: ✓ Done
OpenAdapt: ■ Stopped. Not marked done. 8.1s
Why: OpenAdapt reads the record back from the database after each save. It found nothing, so it stopped.
A save may still have gone through, so a person checks the record before anything is retried.
The screen said "Encounter saved". The database had nothing. A bot that trusts the screen reports Done. OpenAdapt stoppe
Your Seal: Saved and checked
6 of 6 steps · 2 of 2 record checks · 0 model calls

Next: Give your agent this task as a tool
claude mcp add openadapt -- openadapt agent serve --allow-run
Any other MCP client: openadapt agent serve --allow-run
More next steps: openadapt quickstart --more
